isEx is the value written for updAds in _isExcludedMaxTransactionAmount
enabled is directly assigned to swapEnabled
_marketingFee is only assigned to buyMarketingFee/buyTotalFees
_liquidityFee is only assigned to buyLiquidityFee/buyTotalFees
_devFee is only assigned to buyDevFee/buyTotalFees
account is only used as the mapping key in _isExcludedFromFees
isBlacklisted is only written into the _blacklist mapping
pair is validated against uniswapV2Pair and stored in automatedMarketMakerPairs
value is the boolean stored for the AMM pair
newMarketingWallet only becomes the marketingWallet state value
newWallet only becomes the devWallet state value
from is the transfer source consumed entirely by _transfer
to is the transfer destination consumed entirely by _transfer
amount is consumed by the fee and limit arithmetic in _transfer
tokenAmount is only approved and swapped by swapTokensForEth during swapBack
ethAmount is only forwarded as the msg.value of addLiquidityETH
contractTokenBalance is a temporary balance read local to _transfer
fees is a temporary fee value computed and consumed inside _transfer
takeFee is a temporary boolean controlling fee deduction in _transfer
isBuy is a temporary boolean selecting the early-sell branch in _transfer
contractBalance is a temporary balance local to swapBack
totalTokensToSwap is a temporary sum computed and used inside swapBack
liquidityTokens is a temporary amount computed inside swapBack

initialETHBalance is a temporary snapshot used only in swapBack
ethBalance is a temporary delta used only in swapBack

ethForDev is the exact value forwarded in the devWallet low-level call
